description.value: Pür & Simple is a Canadian breakfast and brunch franchise chain with over 65 locations across North America, bringing upscale daytime dining to Kelowna with creative twists on comfort-food classics like Eggs Benedict, pancakes, French toast, and waffles. The restaurant also offers a full Nespresso coffee bar, smoothies, and a kids menu, making it a well-rounded fueling stop for groups of all sizes. Both dine-in and online ordering for delivery or takeout are available.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at pursimple.com/restaurant/kelowna/ confirms an active Pür & Simple location at 1575 Banks Road, Kelowna BC, with phone (778) 940-6881, corroborating the OSM record's brand and category. Takeout is explicitly offered ('order online for delivery or takeout'), and the Alberta and Ontario menu pages (representative of the chain's menu) clearly label Vegan (Vg), Vegetarian (V), and gluten-sensitive options. No bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere in the website content.
concerns: OSM record has empty address and phone fields; both values were sourced from the business website rather than OSM tags.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible breakfast restaurant confirmed active by website with current address and phone; a reliable dining stop for touring cyclists.
